name: Dallas
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Dallas County’s first-party public-works GIS page directs parcel users to Dallas Central Appraisal District. The City of Dallas GIS publishes a tax-parcel service expressly covering the city and a one-mile buffer, using certified data from its five county appraisal districts.
scopeLimits: 115 valid, distinct City of Dallas tax-parcel polygons verified in thirteen bounded cells around the ranked WUP locator. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row paging, all fresh GIS_ACCT reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed. Independent GEOS found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. GIS_ACCT is the advertised display/account field; county metadata is blank on one sampled record and is not synthesized. Native account identity is verified only within this sample and these live re-reads. Citywide completeness, present legal boundaries and permanence of accounts are unverified.
